name: height-field
title: Height field
description: A height in centimetres or in feet and inches, with a unit switch that converts what is typed and always reports one number in centimetres.
docs: value speaks whole centimetres whatever unit was typed, or null; the second argument of onValueChange says whether it is inside min and max (50 and 250), and a height outside them is still reported. unit and onUnitChange control the cm / ftin switch; without unit the field guesses from locale. Switching never changes the stored height.
